title: QOL-TOOLKIT
description: An Improvement mod from minecraft with simple features
body:
# QoL Toolkit

**A lightweight, client-side quality-of-life mod for Minecraft 26.2 — no server required.**

QoL Toolkit bundles the small-but-essential features that vanilla Minecraft is missing into a single, zero-dependency mod. Everything is toggleable, nothing is forced on you, and it works on any server you join.

---

## Features

### 🗺️ Info HUD
A clean heads-up display showing your coordinates, FPS, light level, compass bearing, current biome, XP level, armor durability, and your last death location — all in one place. Toggle with **F6**.

### 📋 Smarter Tooltips
Hover over any item to see extra detail: durability as a percentage, food hunger and saturation values, stack size, and a compact enchantment summary (e.g. `Sharp V · Unbr III · Loot II`) so you can read your gear at a glance.

### ❤️ Target Health Display
See the health of whatever mob your crosshair is resting on, shown directly on your HUD. Toggle with **F8**.

### 📦 Pickup Log
A small on-screen feed that shows the last few items you've picked up — useful when farming or looting chests quickly.

### ⚠️ Chat Warnings
Automatic alerts so nothing sneaks up on you:
- **Low durability** — warns before your tools break
- **Low hunger** — reminds you to eat
- **Wrong tool** — nudges you when you're mining with the wrong item
- **Inventory full** — lets you know before you start losing drops

### 📐 Block Selection Tool
Mark two corners with `/qol pos1` and `/qol pos2`, then use `/qol count` to get a full block-type breakdown of the selected volume. Great for building planning and survival inventory prep.

---

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/qol` | Open the main menu |
| `/qol settings` | Open the settings screen |
| `/qol toggle <feature>` | Toggle any feature without opening the menu |
| `/qol pos1` / `/qol pos2` | Set selection corners to the block you're looking at |
| `/qol count` | Count block types in your selection |
| `/qol selection` | Show current selection corners |
| `/qol clearselection` | Clear the selection |

---

## Keybindings

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| **F6** | Toggle Info HUD |
| **F8** | Toggle Target Health Display |
| **F9** | Open QoL Toolkit menu |

---

## Requirements
- Minecraft **26.2**
- Fabric Loader **0.19.3+**
- Fabric API **0.152.2+26.2**

---

## Notes
- **Client-side only** — works on any multiplayer server, no mod needed server-side
- All settings persist between sessions
